name: dsh-second-thoughts
description: 开工前预检 v0.4：把含糊需求写成可验收句 → 自己找源并用探针验证（0 结果换三组说法重搜）→ 按能力召回直到没有新候选 → 出对照表与覆盖声明 → 交付逐条对账。 A preflight gate for DeepSeek Harness agents: turn vague asks into acceptance sentences, discover and probe your own sources, retry with three alternative phrasings before concluding "none exists", recall by capability, then reconcile before delivery.

meta.title: 三思而后行
meta.description: 开工前预检 v0.6：识别可能是「执行前调查」的步骤 → 先问用户要不要全面预检 → 同意后才走四关。
